Class GuiWallInstance

java.lang.Object
me.leoko.advancedgui.utils.GuiInstance
me.leoko.advancedgui.utils.GuiWallInstance
public class GuiWallInstance extends GuiInstance
The GuiWallInstance is a GuiInstance that displays a layout in a ItemFrame grid on a wall.

      public GuiWallInstance(int id, Layout layout, int activationRadius, GuiLocation location, LayoutManager layoutManager, LocalMetadataManager localMetadataManager)
